series.name: Ben 10
series.fullName: Ben 10 (2005 TV Series) — a.k.a. Ben 10 Classic / the Original Series
movies: Ben 10: Secret of the Omnitrix (2007, animated)
Ben 10: Race Against Time (2007, live action; alternate timeline)
Ben 10: Destroy All Aliens (2012, CGI; set in the OS era)
series.synopsis: On a boring summer road trip with Grandpa Max and cousin Gwen, 10-year-old Ben Tennyson finds the Omnitrix in a crashed pod and can suddenly become 10 alien heroes — Heatblast, Four Arms, XLR8 and the rest — fighting Vilgax, Kevin 11, Hex, Zombozo, Dr. Animo and the Forever Knights across four seasons and three movies.
notes: The wiki infobox lists 52 episodes but the series' own episode page states 49 episodes, three movies and nine shorts (produced as two 26-episode seasons, aired as four seasons plus Secret of the Omnitrix). 49 is used here.
Ben's voice: Tara Strong.

series.name: Ben 10: Alien Force
movies: Ben 10: Alien Swarm (2009, live action; set between production seasons 1 and 2)
series.synopsis: Five years after he removed the Omnitrix, 15-year-old Ben puts it back on when Grandpa Max disappears. The device recalibrates into a sleek new watch with a fresh roster of aliens, and Ben, Gwen and a reformed Kevin Levin form a team to stop the Highbreed/DNAlien invasion, then face the returned Vilgax and Ben's Galvan double Albedo — ending with the Omnitrix destroyed and the Ultimatrix on Ben's wrist.
notes: 3 seasons in US airing order, 2 in production order (the wiki uses production seasons when it says Ben is 15 in 'Season 1' and 16 from 'Season 2').
Ben's voice: Yuri Lowenthal; Ryan Kelley plays him in Alien Swarm.

series.name: Ben 10: Ultimate Alien
series.synopsis: Ben's secret identity is revealed to the world and the 16-year-old becomes a celebrity superhero armed with the Ultimatrix, which can evolve his aliens into Ultimate forms. He battles Aggregor for the Map of Infinity, meets his 10-year-old self at the Forge of Creation, is forced to hunt a mutated Kevin, teams with a future Ben 10,000 against Eon and defeats Dagon — after which Azmuth replaces the Ultimatrix with the completed Omnitrix.
notes: Same art style and design of Ben as Alien Force (wiki 'UAF' label).
Ben's voice: Yuri Lowenthal.

series.name: Ben 10: Omniverse
series.synopsis: With Gwen and Kevin away at college, 16-year-old Ben — redesigned, with a new outfit and the new Omnitrix — is partnered with by-the-book Plumber rookie Rook Blonko and works out of the base beneath Bellwood and the alien district Undertown, fighting Khyber, Malware, Dr. Psychobos, the Incurseans, Vilgax and the rogue Chronosapien Maltruant. Flashbacks show 11-year-old Ben's adventures (and Feedback), and the show opens up the multiverse of alternate Bens and the Time War.
notes: Final series of the classic continuity; art direction by Derrick J. Wyatt.
Ben's voice: Yuri Lowenthal (16) / Tara Strong (11).

devices.name: Prototype Omnitrix
alsoSeenIn: Ultimate Alien (10-year-old Ben in The Forge of Creation)
start of Ben 10 Returns: Part 1 before it reconfigures
Race Against Time (alternate-timeline copy with grey tubes)
devices.creator: Azmuth, with Myaxx and other Galvans
devices.wearer: Ben Tennyson (age 10–11); Ben in the Race Against Time timeline; Gwen and Max in the non-canon 'Gwen 10' what-if
devices.activeTo: Ben 10 Returns: Part 1 (reconfigures into the recalibrated form); the same physical device is later destroyed in The Final Battle: Part 2
devices.appearance: A large wristwatch with a wide band, mainly black and grey. The dark-grey faceplate (dial) carries the green hourglass — the intergalactic peace symbol / Galvan tech logo — on a cylindrical tower: press the side button and the tower pops up, the hourglass inverts into a diamond and shows black silhouettes of the aliens; twist the ring to cycle through them and slam the dial down to transform. Four symmetrical lights on the faceplate ring glow with the hourglass; two rings of white tubing on the band glow green under special circumstances. In Destroy All Aliens and the Omniverse flashbacks it has two side buttons instead of one.

colors.description: black/dark-grey housing and band, bright green hourglass and lights, grey faceplate, white tubing

features: Transforms the wearer into alien species from a selection ('playlist') of 10 at a time — 10 aliens at first, more unlocked over the series (Cannonbolt, Wildvine, Upchuck, Ditto, Eye Guy, Way Big, Benwolf/Blitzwolfer, Benmummy/Snare-Oh, Benvicktor/Frankenstrike, Buzzshock, Spitter, Arctiguana etc.)

Active Mode usage time of about 10 minutes, then it 'times out' into Recharge Mode (hourglass glows red) — a safeguard so alien DNA does not bond permanently; timing out reverts the user; instant recharge/self-activation when the host's life is in direct danger
Collect/Capture Mode (yellow): scans and adds new DNA, in this form by touch (Benwolf, Benmummy, Benvicktor, Cannonbolt, Wildvine…)
Master Control: unlocked briefly by a code in Back With a Vengeance — any alien instantly, no time limit; locked again
Self-Destruct Mode (Secret of the Omnitrix): counts down while charging; charged for days it could destroy the universe; emits a signal ships can pick up
Melds with the host's DNA/skin so it cannot be removed by normal means; energy-feedback blast against anyone forcing it off; auto-reverts a knocked-out user
Quick change between forms / back to human by touching the symbol; symbol placement varies per alien; used the molecules of Ben's clothes to give aliens matching outfits (lost after reconfiguration)
Alien Omnitrix symbols were grey-and-white in the Original Series (retconned in Omniverse as a scratch guard that fell off after Destroy All Aliens)
Protects the transformed user from Ectonurite possession, Corrodium and Animo's mutant ray; contains secret monitors that let Azmuth watch the wearer

colorCoding.orange: Self-Destruct Mode (original form) / alien creation (reconfigured form)

notes: Wiki has one page for the OS and AF forms of the device ('Omnitrix (Original)'); infobox gallery labels: 'Omnitrix (Ben 10).png' = OS, 'Recalibrated Omnitrix.png' = AF.
Working title was the 'Megawatt/Megawhat'; OS design by Dave Johnson.
Retcons: it holds DNA of over a million species (War of the Worlds) and is really a wireless receiver for the Codon Stream on Primus (Primus); originally said to hold 'thousands' of samples.
Ben removed it off-screen after the Omniverse flashbacks (age 11) and kept it as a souvenir until Alien Force.
Kevin's hack in Vengeance of Vilgax: Part 1 briefly reverted the reconfigured watch to this appearance.

image.notes: Infobox image labelled OS on Omnitrix (Original); verified visually — 3/4 render of the grey/black watch with green hourglass and white tubes ('Omnitrix-ben10.PNG' in the gallery redirects to this file).

devices.name: Recalibrated Omnitrix
alsoSeenIn: UA-future Ben 10,000's Omnitrix looks the same
devices.creator: Azmuth (same device; it reconfigured itself when 15-year-old Ben put it back on)
devices.wearer: Ben Tennyson (age 15–16); Azmuth and Vilgax briefly (Primus, The Final Battle)
devices.activeTo: The Final Battle: Part 2 (self-destructs on Vilgax's wrist after a 30-second charge)
devices.appearance: A slimmer, sleeker watch: green wristband with grey side buttons and a round dial whose face is black and green. The interior of the hourglass glows in the colour of the current mode. When Ben selects an alien the dial shows a dark-green hologram of the alien standing on the core (rotatable 360°) instead of a silhouette; slapping the core transforms him. Alien Swarm depicts it in a darker green.

colors.description: green band, light-green hourglass on a black face, grey bezel and side buttons

features: Reconfigured to Ben's teenage biochemistry and gave him a new set of 10 aliens (Swampfire, Echo Echo, Humungousaur, Jetray, Big Chill, Chromastone, Brainstorm, Spidermonkey, Goop, Alien X), later Way Big, Cannonbolt, Diamondhead, Rath, Lodestar, Nanomech, Upchuck, Ghostfreak and others
Same 10-minute usage/Recharge cycle; time-out warning was switched off by the reconfiguration and restored after the reset in War of the Worlds: Part 2
Capture Mode by proximity, not touch (yellow); DNA repair — cured DNAliens/Xenocites and repaired the whole Highbreed species using all its power
Master Control unlockable by Azmuth's voice ('Access Master Control'); Ben and Kevin's own hack attempt failed and released four aliens as feral creatures (Vengeance of Vilgax: Part 1)

Voice Command: 'Omnitrix Voicecommand Mode', 'Omnitrix Command Function Override', 'Decouple Omnitrix Command Code 000 – Release Coupling – 0', 'Omnitrix Self-Destruct in (time): Command code 000 – Destruct – 0'
GPS/hologram map, two-way communicator with Plumber badges, built-in Universal Translator, teleport through Azmuth's channel, tamper flags and DNA/voice-coded security layers
Can create a new species from stored DNA (Nanomech, Alien Swarm) and can synchronize with another Omnitrix

Aliens' eyes take the core's green colour; alien symbol centred on the chest for all AF aliens (a glitch); clothing no longer generated — nanomachines store Ben's clothes, so most aliens appear 'naked' (a bug)
Grants the user an understanding of each alien's powers on transforming (inconsistently — Ben still had to learn Alien X and Chromastone's flight)
notes: Design by Norm Ryang. Ben found the reconfiguration bought him 'new aliens and a new appearance' (Hero Generation series bible: it adapted to his current state).
War of the Worlds: Part 2 implies a full reboot with an all-new roster that the next episode ignores (crew: toyline reasons).
Ben set several DNA/voice security layers on it, one reason Vilgax could not manipulate it as he did in the OS.
Ben briefly wore the pre-recalibrated form at the start of Ben 10 Returns: Part 1 (wiki gallery 'B10R1 (276).png').

image.notes: Infobox image labelled AF on Omnitrix (Original); verified visually — front-on render of the green watch with black/green dial.

devices.name: Ultimatrix
alsoSeenIn: Alien Force finale (The Final Battle: Part 1–2)
Ben 10/Generator Rex: Heroes United (dark green, Rex art style)
devices.creator: Azmuth (built it over years but shelved it with an unstable core); Albedo stole it, stabilized the core and added the evolutionary function
devices.wearer: Albedo (red scheme, The Final Battle: Part 1–2); Ben Tennyson (age 16, from The Final Battle: Part 2 to The Ultimate Enemy: Part 2); the Plant Alien clone briefly (The Big Story)
devices.activeFrom: The Final Battle: Part 1 (Albedo) / The Final Battle: Part 2 (Ben)
devices.activeTo: The Ultimate Enemy: Part 2 — Azmuth removes it and destroys it off-screen, replacing it with the completed Omnitrix
devices.appearance: Called a watch but shaped like a vambrace: a green gauntlet-like band that extends almost halfway up the forearm, light green with a black rectangular button below the selection interface and wrist couplings of two small green tubes on each side over exposed circuitry. The selection interface is the same round dial as the original Omnitrix, its Galvan hourglass changing colour with the mode; when an alien evolves, four grey spikes rise from the dial (the four-pronged 'Ultimate' symbol seen on evolved aliens' chests). It was red while Albedo wore it and turned green for Ben — the user can change the colour scheme.

colors.description: green gauntlet, light-green hourglass, black button/panels, grey dial rim; deep red when worn by Albedo

devices.evolutionaryFunction: Pressing the symbol while transformed puts the alien's DNA through a simulated million-year 'worst-case scenario' evolution and rewrites it to match, producing a more combat-oriented Ultimate form (Ultimate Swampfire, Ultimate Humungousaur, Ultimate Big Chill, Ultimate Echo Echo, Ultimate Spidermonkey, Ultimate Cannonbolt, Ultimate Way Big, Ultimate Wildmutt…). Ultimates drain the battery quickly and trigger Recharge Mode; Azmuth called the function 'begging for trouble', and in The Ultimate Sacrifice the Ultimate forms turned out to be sentient and were released.
features: All the basic Omnitrix functions: playlists of 10, ~10-minute usage then Recharge, quick change, auto-revert when hurt, alien eye colour matches the core

Master Control (unlocked by hacking in Inspector 13, then reset); Reset Mode ('Ultimatrix Reset Code 10' / hold the symbol two seconds) and Hard Reset; Radiation Mode (beeps and flashes red near dangerous radiation, Too Hot to Handle)

Voice Command: 'Command Function Override Code 10', 'Ultimatrix Self-Destruct in (time): Command Code 000 – Destruct 0', 'Abort Self Destruct Code 10', 'Ultimatrix User Access Voice Recognition Mode', 'Ultimatrix Hard Reset'

Collect/Capture Mode fires a yellow scanning ray (unlocked Water Hazard, Armodrillo, AmpFibian, Terraspin, NRG, ChamAlien, Fasttrack, Eatle, Clockwork, Juryrigg, Shocksquatch…) and can extract pure alien DNA from human-alien hybrids
Detects other Matrix cores (Eunice's Unitrix), tracks alien signals, GPS, communicator, Universal Translator, teleports users inside itself, waterproof and bullet-proof
Echo Echo can duplicate the wearer plus Ultimatrix so the copies transform separately (Duped)
Kevin added security keys (carried by Gwen and Kevin) that lock Alien X unless both are inserted (The Forge of Creation)
Slips off when the navy-blue button enlarges the band; adds cosmetic/protective extras to forms (NRG's containment suit, Goop's anti-gravity projector)
notes: Albedo installed more hidden features than are officially known (Dwayne McDuffie); the Ultimatrix's mistransformations were not entirely his shoddy work.
UA Ben 10,000 restored Way Big, Swampfire and Ultimate Swampfire and unlocked further aliens 'to annoy Azmuth' (Ben 10,000 Returns).
Old OS aliens re-added to it wear the black-and-white OS outfit; Four Arms wears gladiator armour, Ripjaws is naked (clothing bug).
The Omniverse 'Ultimatrix (Stabilizer)' is a different device Albedo builds later; Alpha's copy in Heroes United is a replica.
The wiki notes 'four-lobed' spikes only in the evolutionary function; the ordinary dial is described as identical to the original Omnitrix's.

image.notes: Infobox image labelled UA/AF2 on Ultimatrix (Original); verified visually — 3/4 render of the green gauntlet with dial and side button on white.

devices.name: Omnitrix (Omniverse)
alsoSeenIn: Ultimate Alien finale (The Ultimate Enemy: Part 2, drawn by Norm Ryang)
Original Future Timeline (Ben 10,000 gave it to Ken; black side stripes)
devices.creator: Azmuth — worked on it for roughly six years, from the day Ben got the prototype
devices.wearer: Ben Tennyson (age 16, Omniverse); No Watch Ben (temporarily, And Then There Were None / And Then There Was Ben); the Slimebiote Skurd rode on it (Stuck on You → A New Dawn); Ken Tennyson in the future
devices.activeTo: still functioning at series end (A New Dawn)
devices.appearance: Resembles a slim digital wristwatch in white, green and black. The faceplate is square rather than round: black with two green stripes outlining the hourglass logo, on a white band edged in green with small green side tabs. Sliding the faceplate back reveals the green core (which resembles the original Omnitrix's faceplate); a holographic ring of alien icons then floats and rotates above it for touch-style selection, and pressing the core transforms Ben. The Original Future replica differs only in black side stripes.

colors.description: white band and body, green stripes/core, black square faceplate

features: Transformation into any unlocked alien (70+ unlocked of 1,000,912+ samples by Store 23) — DNA is stored digitally inside the device, no longer streamed from Primus
Usage time about 15 minutes (Hot Stretch); how the core is slammed affects the limit and Ben has stayed transformed for hours; Recharge Mode and time-out warning; auto-revert when hurt
Quick change between aliens with or without touching the symbol, and voluntary revert so the watch does not time out
Master Control: exists (code / Azmuth's voice) but Azmuth says he will most likely enable it on Ben's 18th birthday
Randomizer function (The Frogs of War: Part 1): cycles Ben through random aliens every few minutes, or one random alien for a short time — a Matt Youngberg idea
Collect/Capture Mode fires a green ray; if new DNA is detected far away all other functions shut down until it is scanned; passive rescans; regained Feedback (Showdown: Part 2) and scanned Whampire

Anti-death fail-safe / self-activation: transforms Ben into the alien he needs to survive (Feedback in A New Dawn); Slide Off mode; distress signal and homing device; security lock with voice recognition ('Omnitrix User Access Voice Recognition Mode') and re-identification after de-aging (Arrested Development)
Life-form lock: 'Command Code 1010 Tennyson Benjamin Disengage Life-Form Lock' (Incursean DNA); can synchronize with another Omnitrix (Ben Again; unlocked new aliens on Ben 23's Hero Watch)
Call mode with voicemail and an 'emergency mode' warning shock, regular digital-watch functions, Universal Translator, flashlight, Omni-Energy defensive shockwave, anti-Galvanic-Mechamorph failsafes
Self-destruct settings shown in It's a Mad, Mad, Mad Ben World: Part 2 (crew member Derrick J. Wyatt disputes that it has one)
Provides culturally appropriate clothing/extras to aliens (the old naked-alien glitch was fixed; Rath was the exception until Skurd); symbol placement varies per alien
No evolutionary function — Ultimate forms are gone for good; a digitized feminine voice instead of Ben's
notes: First mentioned in Map of Infinity; Azmuth withheld it until Ben's maturity satisfied him (The Ultimate Enemy: Part 2). Ben has worn it ever since.
Designed by Matt Youngberg and Shane Poindexter; alien icons by TJ Collins (inspired by Transformers: Animated insignia). Ryang drew its UA cameo from Youngberg's concepts.
Azmuth blames Ben's mistransformations on slamming the core (and scroll pad) too hard (For a Few Brains More).

Alternate-Ben counterparts of this design: Power Watch (Mad Ben, orange/grey with spikes), Negatrix (Nega Ben, black/grey), Bad Ben's mint-green Omnitrix; Benzarro's Zombitrix and Ben 23's Hero Watch are OS-style.
Receives software updates from Galvan Prime; cannot scan magical creatures, Ultimates or mutants.

image.notes: Official artwork from the Omnitrix (Omniverse)/Gallery 'Models and Poses' section (391x800), verified visually — front render of the white/green watch with black square face. The infobox image 'OV Complete Omnitrix.png' (labelled OV) is the same design but only 180x172 px.

otherDevices.name: Biomnitrix
otherDevices.summary: Ben 10,000's dual-Omnitrix system: two dark-green gauntlets with the hourglass symbol that can fuse any two aliens (Fourmungousaur, Atomic-X, Humungoopsaur, Crashocker, Uprigg, Big Chuck). Name coined by Derrick J. Wyatt; unnamed in scripts.

otherDevices.name: Omnitrix (Original Future)
otherDevices.summary: The prototype Omnitrix as it had grown by Ben 10,000's time: a forearm-and-knuckle gauntlet with a larger slanted faceplate, horizontal hourglass, connectors on the white tubes and a fingerless glove; Master Control and 10,000 aliens.

otherDevices.name: Omnitrix (Ultimate Alien Future)
otherDevices.summary: UA Ben 10,000's device; looks like the recalibrated Omnitrix but with everything unlocked including Ultimate Ben.

image.notes: The wiki page reuses the AF Omnitrix render as its infobox image.

otherDevices.name: Hero Watch
otherDevices.summary: Dimension 23's Omnitrix: OS-style body in blue/light-blue with a gold rim and blue interface.

otherDevices.name: Power Watch
otherDevices.summary: Mad Ben's Omnitrix: OV design with grey instead of white, orange instead of green, and five orange spikes.

otherDevices.name: Negatrix
otherDevices.summary: Nega Ben's Omnitrix: OV design with black instead of white and dark grey instead of green.

otherDevices.name: Zombitrix
otherDevices.summary: Benzarro's Omnitrix: a black buckle on his straitjacket sleeve with a purple interface, grey rim and four spikes; core pops up showing purple circuitry.

otherDevices.name: Omnitrix (Bad Ben's Timeline)
otherDevices.summary: Same as the OV Omnitrix but mint-green instead of green.

otherDevices.name: Omnitrix (Albedo's Replica)
otherDevices.summary: Albedo's home-made copy of the Omnitrix that turned him into a Ben duplicate (Good Copy, Bad Copy); Azmuth removed its core. Listed only so Albedo-only forms are not mis-attributed to Ben.
